title: Chat V2 is now built on Chat V3: one chat view underneath

owner_note.text: V2 now draws the same message list as V3 and adds only its ✓/🧠 marks, replies beside their sentence, and its own look, so a fix to V3 fixes V2 too. Two old V2 behaviours were dropped because the new data doesn't carry them: marking the exact words a reply answers, and lifting an answered question to the top of the chat. Either can come back as a setting if you miss it.
